title: Binary ball volume
statement:
For all $n, t \in \bbn$, write $V_q(n,t) = \sum_{i=0}^{t} \binom{n}{i}(q-1)^i$ for the ball volume at radius $t$ of a length-$n$ code over an alphabet of size $q$. Over a binary alphabet, i.e. taking $q = 2$, this reduces to the partial sum of binomial coefficients
\[
  V_2(n,t) = \sum_{i=0}^{t} \binom{n}{i}.
\]
replaced:
For all $n, t \in \bbn$, the ball volume at radius $t$ of a length-$n$ code over a
binary alphabet, i.e. with alphabet size $q = 2$, equals the partial sum of binomial
coefficients
\[
  \mathrm{ballVol}(n, t, 2) = \sum_{i=0}^{t} \binom{n}{i}.
\]
